behavior.name: Register Robot IP
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
Utility Behavior to register a new Robot IP address into the FlexBE manifest.
FLOW: 1. Type the new Robot IP in the parameter field. 2. Click Start Execution. 3. The IP is registered permanently into capture_and_calibrate.xml.

param.name: new_robot_ip
param.label: New Robot IP
param.hint: Type the new IP address to register into the dropdown menu (e.g. 192.168.1.120)
